append.detail: Built 2026-11-10: lib/hunts/flags.ts holds five dark switches (HUNTS_ENABLED, HUNTS_CLAIMS_ENABLED, HUNTS_REWARDS_ENABLED, HUNTS_AUTHORING_ENABLED, HUNTS_WORKER_ENABLED) on envFlag, each on only when its parent is, so a lower rung alone never opens a higher one. Listed blank in .env.example with a one-line gate; activation gate and rollback in docs/RUNBOOKS.md (Frequency Hunts switches). The remaining half of the original ask (synthetic legacy rows, exact-SHA staging checks with all switches off, observability) moved to FH-011S because it needs the switches wired into routes first.
